# Ọbalúayé and the industries that were always telling its story
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Ọbalúayé** never stopped working.

Ọbalúayé's mythology is less a set of heroic adventures than a meditation on illness, marginality, and the earth's power to break and remake the body.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ọbalúayé
- **Pantheon:** Yoruba
- **Domain of influence:** Disease, Healing, Earth
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Health & Wellbeing · Commerce & Governance · Society & Spirit · Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 49 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Scourge of the World.** Ọbalúayé is called 'Father of the World' not because he nurtures it but because his diseases touch everyone, high and low.  In some accounts he was once a proud king who was brought low by sickness and learned compassion only after he himself had suffered. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**The Dog and the Herb.** Stories of Ọbalúayé often involve a dog who leads a sufferer to a healing herb or a stream.  The dog is his messenger, moving between the realm of disease and the realm of cure. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine

*Medicine, pharmaceuticals, and public health. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

*Disease and healing in one figure; syncretized with the patron of the sick.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ọbalúayé performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Disaster Resilience & Recovery

*Emergency management, recovery, and business continuity. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*Lord of epidemics from smallpox onward; pandemic preparedness is the modern discipline of his outbreaks.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ọbalúayé performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Venerated across the Americas as healer of the sick.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ọbalúayé performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Pet Care & Animal Industries

*Pet products, veterinary care, and animal brands. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*His two dogs guide sufferers to healing herbs and guard the boundary between sickness and health; the dog is his messenger.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ọbalúayé performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Ọbalúayé's mythology is less a set of heroic adventures than a meditation on illness, marginality, and the earth's power to break and remake the body. The age changed. The work did not.

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. ## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in healthcare, pharma & medicine, disaster resilience & recovery, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/babaluaye/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
